in_sanskrit.name: नारायणन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Narayanan is a compound name, made up of the words 'nara' meaning 'man' and 'ayana' meaning 'resting place'. In this compound, 'nara' is replaced by the name of the goddess Narayani. So, Narayanan means 'Son of the goddess Narayani'.

in_hindi.name: नारायणान्
in_hindi.long_meaning: नारायणान् नाम नारायणी देवी के पुत्र का नाम है।

in_tamil.name: நாராயணன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: நாராயணன் என்று நரயானியின் புதல்வன் எனக் குறிக்கப்படுகிறது.

in_telugu.name: నారాಯణన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: నారాయణన్ ఎందుకంటే నరయాని దేవీ కు సుత్తుడు.

in_marathi.name: Narayanan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Man
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narayanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narayanan is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit words 'nara' meaning 'man' and 'ayana' meaning 'abode'. It symbolizes the protector and sustainer of all living beings.

in_bengali.name: Narayanan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Man
in_bengali.long_meaning: Narayanan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Narayanan is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit words 'nara' meaning 'man' and 'ayana' meaning 'abode'. It symbolizes the protector and sustainer of all living beings.
